thread:
maya_cs: FYI we've got a NovaHealth escalation — they say search/rerank relevancy dropped after last week's model update. Sent 5 concrete examples (queries + expected doc).

sam_support: copying examples here. customer says top-3 results now contain unrelated policy pages.

maya_cs: they reported the regression yesterday, high business impact (clinical docs). Asking for triage and ETA.

jess_eng: can you paste one minimal repro? also which embedding model & reranker config are they on?

maya_cs: pasted minimal repro: query "post-op wound care" -> expected doc id 3892 but top results are 1201, 443. They were on model "redwood-embed-1-small" + reranker v1.2 with cosine sim threshold 0.78.

liam_data: interesting — metrics on our side show a 6% drop in MRR on that customer cohort after 2024-11-07 deploy. That aligns with the embedding model bump.

deploy-bot: deploy v2024-11-07-redwood-embed-1-small rolled at 2024-11-07T03:12:45Z by @eng-release.

jess_eng: quick triage: need (1) eval set from customer (we have 5 examples, want ~100 if possible), (2) hist embeddings for their docs to check drift, (3) exact reranker scoring logs for those queries. anyone owning logs access?

sam_support: I can request expanded set from NovaHealth, but they may need a quick mitigation. They asked if we can roll back to previous embedding variant as a hotfix.

oliver_prod: priority check: this is P1 for NovaHealth (enterprise with SLA). Options: rollback embed model for them only (targeted rollback), adjust reranker thresholds, or tune prompt/encoder. Need scope + acceptance criteria. Prod/eng to weigh cost.

jess_eng: technical note — per-customer rollback is supported but nontrivial: we need a pinned model variant and config change, scheduling and cache warmup. Estimated 4-8 engineer-hours to do safely plus monitoring.

liam_data: alternative: run a rapid ablation to see whether embedding change or reranker delta causes most MRR drop. I can run on their sampled docs overnight if they send ~100 docs by EOD.

maya_cs: customer can provide 120 docs by EOD if we promise prioritized attention. They want temporary rollback if ablation points to embed.

oliver_prod: decision: start ablation immediately (liam), request expanded eval (sam), and prep rollback playbook (jess). If ablation shows embedding is root cause, approve targeted rollback for NovaHealth with expedited rollout. Tagging @eng-sre for monitoring.

sam_support: pinged customer for docs and granted them a temporary escalation channel.

jess_eng: creating internal ticket PROD-8509 with acceptance criteria: restored MRR within 1% baseline for their queries OR targeted rollback completed and verified. I'll add steps + ownership.

maya_cs: thanks — I'll keep NovaHealth updated. please post updates here. :thumbsup:

liam_data: starting ablation run now, will share preliminary signal in ~10h.

deploy-bot: ticket PROD-8509 created by jess_eng at 2024-11-08T12:45:01Z.
